sources.title: Cancillería: Servicios — Solicitud de visas
sources.publisher: Ministerio de Relaciones Exteriores del Estado Plurinacional de Bolivia
sources.officialityEvidence: Live central Foreign Ministry page replayed over normal valid HTTPS. It defines the tourist Groups I, II and III and says visas are issued by Bolivian consulates and embassies, but provides no country schedule for the 20 residual passports.
sources.supportingExcerpt: La visa es un documento de viaje emitido por los Consulados y Embajadas de Bolivia en el exterior.

sources.title: Sistema de Solicitud Visas
sources.publisher: Ministerio de Relaciones Exteriores del Estado Plurinacional de Bolivia
sources.officialityEvidence: Live Ministry application front end replayed over normal valid HTTPS. It exposes an application workflow, not an ordinary-passport nationality schedule or an electronically issued entry document for any scoped passport.

unresolved.reason: Current Foreign Ministry guidance defines Groups I/II/III and consular issuance, but publishes no nationality assignment for this ordinary passport. The public application portal provides no terminal issuance result. Its underlying country API cannot be used: normal TLS validation fails and the records for this residual lack a reliable group mapping.
